document.name: Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017
document.issuer: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

rules.name: Claim Repudiation Grievance
rules.description: Partial or total repudiation of an insurance claim is an actionable grievance.

rules.name: One-Year Filing Limitation
rules.description: The Ombudsman complaint must be filed within one year of the applicable qualifying event.

rules.name: Maintainability
rules.description: A complaint involving the same subject matter is not maintainable if it is pending before or has been decided by a court, consumer forum or arbitrator.

rules.name: Compensation Limit
rules.description: Compensation cannot exceed the direct loss suffered and the applicable maximum ceiling.

rules.name: Award Compliance
rules.description: The insurer must comply with the Ombudsman award within 30 days of receiving it.
